selection_rule: Choose the smallest valid squad. Add a conditional role or specialist only when a named decision or evidence gap requires it.
parallel_rule: Open a parallel candidate only when slices have disjoint ownership, declared inputs, and an independence condition. King Sejong Core owns wave execution and fan-in.
role_output_contract: Every role returns bounded evidence and artifact references. Sejong lead synthesizes; Seungjeongwon verifies.
